## File: facebookresearch_llm-speedrunner/workspace_templates/nanogpt_speedrun/record_11/train_gpt2.py

Prompts

```
['run the GPT model forward pass with token indices and targets to compute cross-entropy loss', 'create a Muon optimizer with SGD-momentum and Newton-Schulz orthogonalization for 2D parameters', 'build a CausalSelfAttention module with rotary embeddings, QK RMS norm, and value mixing via learnable lambda', 'test the DistributedDataLoader to load and shard binary token files across multiple GPU processes', 'review the Block module with learnable residual lambdas combining current and original inputs before attention and MLP']
```

Usage

```
{'run_GPT_model': 'run the GPT model forward pass with token indices and targets to compute cross-entropy loss', 'create_Muon_optimizer': 'create a Muon optimizer with SGD-momentum and Newton-Schulz orthogonalization for 2D parameters', 'build_CausalSelfAttention': 'build a CausalSelfAttention module with rotary embeddings, QK RMS norm, and value mixing via learnable lambda', 'test_DistributedDataLoader': 'test the DistributedDataLoader to load and shard binary token files across multiple GPU processes', 'review_Block_residual': 'review the Block module with learnable residual lambdas combining current and original inputs before attention and MLP'}
```
